findings.title: The reorder adds a new deadlock between the worker RPC and the internal job_files DELETE (ON DELETE SET NULL). The PR discloses it, but no follow-up issue exists yet
findings.evidence: The parts.cad_file_id and drawing_file_id FKs are ON DELETE SET NULL (20260303101500_curated_cnc_quote_platform.sql:163-164). The SET NULL also fires the assign_canonical_part_version trigger (20260812042000:618-620). A DELETE therefore locks the file row first, then the part rows. Before the fix the RPC also started at job_files, so the two could not form a cycle. After the fix (migration :52-65) the RPC takes parts first. A concrete same-blob sequence, from reading the code (not raced): (1) the worker registers sibling file F21 and holds parts P1 and P21 while parked on F21. (2) An internal DELETE of F1 locks F1 and waits on P1, which the worker holds. (3) F21 is released, and the worker's same-blob UPDATE (:79-87) waits on F1, which the DELETE holds. That is a 40P01. Under 'Rollback / risk notes' the PR body says the DELETE path 'is now reversed against the worker as well', was not raced, and fails closed. That matches the Linear acceptance criterion, which only requires documenting it. Opening the follow-up issue is still a coordinator decision, and it is not done.
findings.suggested_fix: Coordinator: open the follow-up issue the PR body asks for (job_files DELETE SET NULL plus the archived-job cascade lock order). Put the same-blob interleaving above in it as the race to add. No change is needed in this PR.
